newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Oce shares rise after Q3 profit jump.
newsitem.headline: Oce shares rise after Q3 profit jump.

text.p: Shares in photocopier maker Oce-van der Grinten NV were up 4.20 guilders, over two percent, to 197.40 on Wednesday after the group posted a 71 percent jump in third quarter net profits to 38.9 million guilders.
The company also said it expected further strong growth in the fourth quarter, which dealers said was possibly more significant than the earnings figure itself.
Analysts welcomed the rise. "We're very satisfied with the results and comfortable with our estimates," Bank Labouchere's Ad van der Laar said. "We expect further good messages."
